name: fader
title: Fader
summary: An upright fader, as on a console: an inset groove filled with ink from the bottom and a raised cap with the accent line.
use: For levels people ride: input, output, mix, volume. Side by side in a bank.

options.name: level
options.description: A live level on a vertical meter beside the groove.

options.name: onEditingChanged
options.description: Called when a drag, click or reset starts and ends, so a gesture is one undo step.

rules: Faders stand upright; use the slider for a value in a row.
The cap's line is the live mark in the accent; nothing else on a fader takes it.
A meter beside a fader shows a level, never the fader's own value.
accessibility: Adjustable with the arrow keys; the reading is announced.
